description: Replace lugh's former in-repo reads of pinakes files with the cross-repo handoff: vendor the 3 contract/fixture inputs as byte-mirrors with drift gates, and wire the corpus as a pulled published artifact. This severs the last coupling to the pinakes working tree. See pinakes docs/LUGH-EXTRACTION-PLAN.md.

userStories.title: Vendor the 3 contract/fixture files with drift gates
userStories.description: Bring canonical-schema.json, rules_registry.tsv, and the insimul world-export.json fixture into lugh as vendored byte-mirrors, each with a drift-failing test (the koine-mirror pattern).
acceptanceCriteria: vendor/ (or contracts/) holds byte-identical copies of contracts/canonical-schema.json, engine/.../datalog/rules_registry.tsv, and engine/tests/fixtures/insimul/world-export.json from pinakes.
Each has a drift test that fails if the vendored copy differs from the recorded upstream hash, with a documented refresh command (sync-from-pinakes).
All ml modules now read the vendored copies (no _REPO_ROOT paths pointing outside lugh); pinakes_ml imports and tests pass.

userStories.title: Corpus via pulled published artifact
userStories.description: Replace the build/corpus default with a LUGH_CORPUS_DIR override that points at a pulled+verified corpus tarball (produced by pinakes:91-publish-corpus-artifact); skip live-corpus tests when absent.
acceptanceCriteria: The corpus input resolves via LUGH_CORPUS_DIR (env/config), with a helper that downloads + sha256-verifies the published corpus artifact.
Live-corpus tests skipif LUGH_CORPUS_DIR is unset/absent (CI stays green fixture-only); with a corpus present they run.
No lugh module references a pinakes-relative path anymore.
